**Feature Request: Local Desktop Display for Media Players**

I would like to request a feature that allows media players to display a **local desktop**.

This feature is intended to work as a **client-side media source** that is only visible to the local user. It is **not** intended to share or synchronize the desktop with other players.

I often spend time alone in chill worlds, enjoying the atmosphere while watching videos. If I could display my PC desktop on an in-world screen, it would make it possible to work on my PC from within VRChat and open up new ways to enjoy spending time in virtual spaces.

The feature could work as follows:

* Local only (visible only to the local user)

* No network synchronization

* No network streaming required

I understand this may not be a high-priority feature, but I believe it would make VRChat even more appealing—not only as a social platform, but also as a relaxing and productive virtual environment.

**If necessary, I think this could also be offered as a VRChat Plus feature, providing additional value for Plus subscribers.**

Thank you for your consideration.
title: Add Local Desktop Display to Media Players
